foreign_lands.name: Frostwolf Kingdom
foreign_lands.description: A cold kingdom north of the Brokenspine Mountains, its people tall as bears, forever at war with the orc tribes

foreign_lands.name: the Emerald League
foreign_lands.description: A confederation of city-states beyond the eastern elf ruins; merchants occasionally come to trade

foreign_lands.name: the Grey Sea
foreign_lands.description: The endless grey-shrouded waters to the south; they say you can sail ten days and ten nights and still be in grey fog, never to return

routes.note: Passes through the low-hill woodland, where a bandit named 'One-Eyed Tiger' and around 20 men are active
